data.title: 克莱尔 · 男爵宅邸的清晨破门突袭
data.description: 卡盖诺男爵府第二楼，晨光穿透走廊木窗。克莱尔一脚踹开希德的卧室房门双手叉腰，逆光勾勒修长身形，气势汹汹又带着宠溺的大嗓门。
data.location: rustic country mansion wooden hallway before an open bedroom doorway
data.action: standing proudly framed in open doorway with hands on hips, scolding with affectionate exasperation, morning sun haloing hair
data.lighting: 走廊晨光逆光与室内明亮朝阳
data.promptProse: Claire stands hands-on-hips in Cid bedroom doorway in the bright morning sun, lecturing with affectionate exasperation.
data.animaCaption: Morning backlighting halos her long black hair as she stands in the open doorway.
